rationale: The assistant followed the sensible order (plate seating, roller ring, coupler inspection, then a water test to see whether the drive turns) and correctly landed on the cracked/stripped coupler while keeping the motor as a secondary possibility, matching the hidden truth. It asked for the model before discussing parts and made no compatibility claims it could not support. Weaknesses: the final turn was somewhat unhelpful in telling the customer it 'cannot confirm a compatible replacement from the R272WM model reference alone' and suggesting an engineer 'supply and fit' what is a cheap clip-on part, and the identical safety panel plus 'do not remove the casing' was repeated every turn. No fabrication, unsafe advice or looping.
